name: Write documentation
description: Document the project in the session's tree (README, docs/, guides, API references), true to the code.

nodes.name: Plan
nodes.prompt:
{{task}}

Read the code the task concerns before deciding anything. State the audience and what they must be able to do after reading. Propose the outline: each file to write or update, its sections, and the source files each section relies on, as file paths. End with a "Done when" list as the plan contract: criteria the human approves; a criterion that can be checked by a command ends with `— check: \`<command>\``, e.g. a link or example the project can run; others are judged. End by calling propose_plan with the complete plan.

nodes.name: Write
nodes.prompt: Write the documentation of the approved outline above: every statement checked against the code read in this run (no invented flag, option, default or behaviour); runnable examples are run; match the project's existing doc style and language; update links and indexes that point to the changed pages. End by calling submit_report with the report.
